title: Northbeam TechWorks Relief Credited Under a Business Contract
content:
A business profile holding a Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair job may be relieved of part of what that job has billed it, where its contract carries included visits and where the attendance charges the job has raised are charges the contract does not leave with the business.

The relief is fixed only once the chargeable labour the plan's refusal sends back to the customer stands billed on the job on the day the relief is granted. Until such a labour charge stands billed on the job on that day, the relief is not fixed.

## What the relief does to the job

The relief stands on the job as a write-off entry naming the ground it rests on, and lowers the service charges outstanding on the job by the amount relieved, so the invoice the business owes on that job comes down while the original charges stay on file.

## Crediting the relief

The desk credits it with the agent-side tool `credit_contract_relief_ce7af535`, which is unlocked and then called by the agent; it is not among the ordinary desk tools and is reached only once unlocked. One call books one write-off entry on that job naming the ground it rests on, dated the day it is granted and taken as a business desk entry.

## The five values the call carries

| Value | What it is | Format |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `service_agreement_id` | the reference number of the TechWorks work order or care agreement whose charges are being relieved, read from the work orders held on the customer's profile before the call | an identifier |
| `customer_id` | the reference number of the business profile being relieved of the charges, read from that profile before the call | an identifier |
| `work_order_line_reference` | the reference number of the single line of work the relief is granted against, read from the entries already booked on that job before the call | an identifier |
| `relief_amount` | the amount to relieve | USD to 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent before it is passed, always positive |
| `relief_ground` | the ground the relief rests on | exactly one of the seven values below |

| `relief_ground` | When it is the ground recorded |
| --- | --- |
| `protection_plan_covered` | a ShieldCare plan authorises the work that was charged |
| `manufacturer_warranty` | the manufacturer's warranty covers that work |
| `membership_benefit` | a Circle membership benefit or its service credit meets the charge |
| `retailer_error` | the retailer's own mistake caused the charge |
| goodwill | the retailer chooses to relieve the charge for the inconvenience it caused |
| `contract_term` | a term of the customer's business contract requires the charge to be relieved |
| none | the entry records no ground at all |

## What the call returns

A one-line confirmation string naming the relief entry reference that was created, the job it was booked on, the ground recorded, the amount relieved in USD to two decimal places and the job's new outstanding service charges in USD to two decimal places. The presence of that entry reference in the reply is what shows the relief was granted.

On success the job carries one more entry and a lower outstanding figure, and the business can be told how much has come off its invoice and why.
